svg.title: How a record's default scope and category are set, and when a justification is asked
svg.desc: A reviewed record names a source stream, whose kind fixes the categories it can take and whose ownership sets the default scope: an owned combustion or process stream defaults to scope 1, purchased electricity to scope 2, and a contractor-operated stream to scope 3. If the facility is leased, Appendix F of the Standard decides the scope under the inventory's approach and no justification is asked. If you choose a scope other than the default, a justification of at least 10 characters is required or the Classification gate errors. If you mark the factor as a proxy, a justification is required before anything is saved. If the factor is not approved, the Emission factors gate holds the run until someone approves it.

span.p:
Stream kind fixes the categories;
ownership sets the default scope:
owned combustion or process: scope 1
purchased electricity: scope 2
contractor-operated: scope 3
